mindtraced_atomic_units: Design a module with 8 D flip-flops.
Each flip-flop has an active-high synchronous reset.
The reset sets the output to zero on the next positive clock edge.
Flip-flops are triggered by the positive edge of the clock.
The module has an input clock signal 'clk'.
The module has an 8-bit input data vector 'd'.
The module has an input reset signal 'reset'.
The module has an 8-bit output data vector 'q'.
